    How to use it

    1. Add photos (choose, drop or paste), record a short camera clip, or try the sample.
    2. Put the frames in order. Drag them, or use Earlier / Later.
    3. Pick a size, crop, speed, loop and colours. Watch the preview.
    4. Press Make GIF, then Download GIF.
    Do thisPhoneKeyboard
    Add photosTap Choose photosTab to it, Enter (or Ctrl + V to paste)
    Record a clipRecord clip, then RecordTab to the buttons, Enter
    ReorderDrag a frame sideways, or tap it then Earlier / LaterShift + ← → on a frame
    Remove a frameTap it, then RemoveDelete on a frame
    SettingsTap the pills, drag the slidersTab, then arrows
    Make + saveMake GIF, then Download GIFTab to it, Enter
